title: The Contractor's Guide to Surviving Thanksgiving Week (Without Losing Money or Your Mind)
summary: Thanksgiving week hits construction businesses harder than almost any other time of year — crews want time off, clients delay payments, suppliers close early, and cash flow grinds to a halt. This guide breaks down why the holiday week creates such severe financial strain and shows contractors how to stay profitable and stress-free using Truss. From getting paid before the holiday with instant payment links, to scheduling free ACH payments for subs, to using Balance Protection for timing gaps, contractors learn exactly how to keep projects on track while still enjoying time with family. Includes a step-by-step Thanksgiving Week Action Plan to prepare the business, secure cash flow, and enter December strong.
